release.notes_on_special_items: Q4-2022 release (three months ended Dec 31, 2021 column). Acquisition-amortization and other related charges now includes transaction expenses, amortization of intangibles, fair value charges on acquired inventories and integration expenses (not split). Separation costs allocated to segments as % of revenue. Discrete tax adjustments for 2021 = net discrete tax expenses related to the separation from Enovis. Tax effect line printed +3.1. SEGMENT RECAST: the Q1-2022 release showed Q4-2021 Americas OI 27.1 / EMEA 45.9 and adj EBITDA 42.7 / 59.9 (total 73.0 / 102.6 unchanged); the Q4-2022 release moved ~3.0 of OI/EBITDA from EMEA & APAC to Americas.

notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).
EPS for pre-spin periods computed by the company on 60,034,311 shares (shares distributed at Separation); basic = diluted. No dividends declared pre-spin (dps_declared=0).
Q4 IS ties to FY2021 (10-K) less 9M-2021 (Q3-2022 10-Q) on every line (e.g. net sales 2,428,115-1,803,900=624,215).
shares_basic/diluted null: no Q4-2021 share count printed (company used 60,034,311 for all 2021 periods).
product_lines DERIVED = FY2021 (10-K) minus 9M-2021 (Q3-2022 10-Q): equipment 758,267-564,971=193,296; consumables 1,669,848-1,238,929=430,919 thousand (sum 624,215).
Segment net sales derivable from 10-K FY less 9M 10-Q: Americas 1,004,208-739,793=264,415; EMEA & APAC 1,423,907-1,064,107=359,800 thousand (release 264.4/359.8).
Russia net sales Q4-2021 48.8 (Q4-2022 release core sales footnote). Russia adj EBITDA 4.9.
Adjusted NI Q4-2021: tax effect +3.1 and discrete tax +5.2 (net discrete tax expenses related to the separation).

Q1-2022 release earlier version of Q4-2021 segment recon: OI Americas 27.1 / EMEA 45.9; adj EBITA 38.9/54.2/93.1; adj EBITDA 42.7/59.9/102.6 (recast in Q4-2022 release; values used here are from the Q4-2022 release).
